summary: A woman long active in civic groups says she saw herself as an administrator, watched local fights from the side, then agreed times had changed.
realLife: In an oral history a county board member recalled leading civic groups, being teased about a church council as practice, and deciding to run once she had served on the planning body.
sources: Arlington Public Library, oral history on getting involved in local politics, Mar. 7, 2019: https://library.arlingtonva.us/2019/03/07/oral-history-getting-involved-in-local-politics/
